names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him, which day-candidates.mjs prints as `name: Павел (Фаворитов), иерей, сщмч.`; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself declining the bare forename only. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE; `peter-favoritov` carries the same surname and another forename.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives for him; no year of birth, and no reading of his own.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Аркадия, еп. Бежецкого, Илии, Павла, Феодосия, Владимира, Александра пресвитеров, прмч. Макария (1937).»

attestations.note: The third of the seven men of the day’s seventh line, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS FOR HIM: the line carries six readings for seven men, and all six belong to the other six — the titles were read and his name is on none of them. No `related` rows join the seven, for the reason given on the bishop’s row. No folder held him: `fk.mjs` on «Павел (Фаворитов)» returns NONE, and a Cyrillic grep for «Фаворитов» over every `saint.json` returns `peter-favoritov` alone, a different forename. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, AND THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED.
